statement:
∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s →
 ∀ (p : GDVec (n + 1) → GDVec n) (q : GDVec (n + 1) → ℝ),
 (∀ x t, p (GDPoint x t) = x ∧ q (GDPoint x t) = t) →
 LipschitzWith 1 p →
 ∀ (K : Set ℕ) (V : K → Set (GDVec (n + 1))) (J : K → Set ℝ),
 GDProduct E ⊆ ⋃ i, V i →
 (∀ i, Metric.ediam (V i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) →
 (∀ i, q '' V i ⊆ J i) →
 ∀ t ∈ GDInterval, GDContent s δ E ≤
   ∑' i, (J i).indicator (fun _ => (Metric.ediam (V i)) ^ s) t
proof:
classical
  intro s δ hs p q hinv hp K V J hcov hd hJ t ht
  let U : K → Set (GDVec n) := fun i => if t ∈ J i then p '' V i else ∅
  have hproj (i : K) : Metric.ediam (p '' V i) ≤ Metric.ediam (V i) := by
    simpa using hp.ediam_image_le (V i)
  apply @yui_aux_0002 n E h_T004 h_T009 s δ K U
    (fun i => (J i).indicator (fun _ => (Metric.ediam (V i)) ^ s) t)
  · intro x hx
    have hxt : GDPoint x t ∈ GDProduct E := ⟨x, hx, t, ht, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcov hxt)
    have hti : t ∈ J i := hJ i ⟨GDPoint x t, hi, (hinv x t).2⟩
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    simp only [U, if_pos hti]
    exact ⟨GDPoint x t, hi, (hinv x t).1⟩
  · intro i
    by_cases hti : t ∈ J i
    · simpa [U, hti] using (hproj i).trans (hd i)
    · simp [U, hti]
  · intro i
    by_cases hti : t ∈ J i
    · simp only [U, if_pos hti, Set.indicator_of_mem hti]
      exact iSup_le fun _ => ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (hproj i) hs.le
    · simp [U, hti, Set.indicator_of_notMem, GDCost]

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)),
  Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
      0 ≤ dimH E ∧
        dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧
          dimH E < ∞ ∧ (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GDContent s δ E < ∞) ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0) →
    ((∀ (x y : GDVec n) (t u : ℝ), dist (GDPoint x t) (GDPoint y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
        ∀ (z : GDVec (n + 1)), ∃ x t, z = GDPoint x t) →
      ∀ (s δ : ℝ),
        0 < s →
          ∀ (p : GDVec (n + 1) → GDVec n) (q : GDVec (n + 1) → ℝ),
            (∀ (x : GDVec n) (t : ℝ), p (GDPoint x t) = x ∧ q (GDPoint x t) = t) →
              LipschitzWith 1 p →
                ∀ (K : Set ℕ) (V : ↑K → Set (GDVec (n + 1))) (J : ↑K → Set ℝ),
                  GDProduct E ⊆ ⋃ i, V i →
                    (∀ (i : ↑K), Metric.ediam (V i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) →
                      (∀ (i : ↑K), q '' V i ⊆ J i) →
                        ∀ t ∈ GDInterval,
                          GDContent s δ E ≤ ∑' (i : ↑K), (J i).indicator (fun x => Metric.ediam (V i) ^ s) t
